home.heading: Shopify + Cloudflare scaffold
home.runtimeBody: This app runs in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. Sessions live in KV, app state lives in D1 via Drizzle, and both are real bindings in local dev as well as production.
home.installMissing: No install row in D1 yet — it is written when OAuth completes.

feedback.heading: We're new, and we're listening
feedback.body: This app is just getting started, and we ship fast based on what merchants tell us. Something missing, something broken, or an idea that would make your day easier? Send it our way.
feedback.action: Share feedback or request a feature

dashboard.heading: Overview
dashboard.intro: Here is what is happening across your store today.
dashboard.manageProductsBody: Keep your catalog fresh and ready to sell.
dashboard.viewOrdersBody: Review the latest orders and fulfillment status.
dashboard.marketingBody: Bring more customers back with a campaign.
dashboard.feedbackBody: These sample metrics are ready to replace with your store data as you connect more features.

setupGuide.heading: Finish setting up your store
setupGuide.body: Complete these steps to start selling with confidence.

steps.connectBody: Link your sales channels and preferences.
steps.connectAlt: Person preparing a store setup checklist
steps.catalogBody: Build a catalog shoppers will love.
steps.analyticsBody: See which channels are driving growth.

errors.missingShop: Please enter your shop domain to log in
errors.invalidShop: Please enter a valid shop domain to log in

billing.heading: Billing

current.trial: Your free trial ends {{date}}. After that, you'll be charged {{price}}.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.body: Choose or change your plan any time.

billing.managedNote: Plans are managed by Shopify. Use the button above to view available plans, upgrade, or change your subscription.

processing.heading: Updating your plan
processing.body: Checking the latest details from Shopify. This usually takes only a moment.
processing.failedHeading: We could not update your plan
processing.failedBody: Try again to check the latest details from Shopify.

billing.loadFailedBody: Reload the page to try again. If this keeps happening, contact support.
billing.planLinkUnavailable: The plan link is unavailable right now. Reload the page to try again.

support.heading: Support

empty.heading: No tickets yet
empty.body: When something looks wrong or you want a feature, open a ticket and we will reply here.

form.heading: What can we help with?
form.category: What kind of issue is this?
form.subject: Subject
form.bodyHelp: What you expected, what happened instead, and where. A screenshot or recording helps most.
form.emailHelp: We reply here as well as in the app. Clear it to only be notified in the app.
form.ccHelp: They get every reply, and can reply themselves. Up to {{max}}.
form.attachmentLimits: Up to 10 MB images, 100 MB video, and 25 MB files

thread.replyPlaceholder: Add anything else that might help
thread.closedNotice: This ticket is closed. Reply to reopen it.
thread.notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Go back to your tickets to find it.

errors.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages just now. Try again in a minute.
errors.empty_reply: Write a message or attach a file.
errors.upload_failed: That file could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.unsupported_type: That file type is not supported.
errors.invalid_cc: That copy list is not valid. Use one email address per line.
errors.invalid_cc_email: That does not look like an email address.
errors.duplicate_cc_email: That address is already on the list.
errors.too_many_cc_emails: The list is full. Remove someone to add another.

success.created: Ticket sent. We will reply here.

support.loadFailedBody: Reload the page to try again. If this keeps happening, contact support.

pending.heading: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your request to use {{appName}} has been sent. When an owner of this store lets you in, reload this page.

removed.heading: You no longer have access
removed.body: An owner of this store removed you from {{appName}}. Ask them to restore your access.

not_invited.heading: You need an invitation
not_invited.body: {{appName}} is open to people an owner of this store has invited. Ask an owner to invite your email address.

forbidden.heading: You do not have permission for this
forbidden.body: Your role does not include this page. Ask an owner of this store to change your role.

members.heading: Team
members.intro: The people from your store who can use {{appName}}, and what each of them can do.

policy.auto_join: Anyone on your store's Shopify staff who opens {{appName}} joins automatically as {{role}}. Change anyone's role here.
policy.invite_only: Only people you invite can use {{appName}}. They join the first time they open it with the invited email address.
policy.approval: Anyone on your store's Shopify staff who opens {{appName}} waits here until you let them in.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including the plan. Every store always has at least one owner.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Runs the app day to day and manages the team. Cannot change the plan.

member.label: Member
member.description: Uses the app and changes its settings and data.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Can look but not change anything.

invite.heading: Invite a member
invite.emailHint: They join the first time they open {{appName}} with this address verified in Shopify.

seats.heading: Seats
seats.full: Every seat is in use. Remove someone or change your plan to let more people in.
seats.over: Your plan's seat limit is {{max}} and {{used}} are in use. Nobody is removed, but nobody new can join until you are within the limit.

waiting.heading: People are waiting to be let in: {{count}}
waiting.body: They opened {{appName}} and cannot use it yet. Let them in below, or remove them.

confirmRemove.heading: Remove {{name}}?
confirmRemove.body: They lose access to {{appName}} straight away. You can restore them later.

success.invited: Invitation sent. They can join the next time they open the app.
success.approved: They can use the app now.

errors.forbidden: You cannot do that. Only an owner or admin can manage the team, and only for roles at or below their own.
errors.notFound: That person is no longer on the team.
errors.notYourself: You cannot change or remove your own membership here. Ask another owner.
errors.lastOwner: Every store needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.noSeat: Your plan has no free seat for another person. Remove someone or change your plan.
errors.invalidState: That person changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.alreadyMember: That address is already on the team or has an open invitation.
errors.roleInvalid: Choose one of the listed roles.
